events.title: The Message about John's Birth to Zechariah
events.description: The priest Zechariah is visited by the angel Gabriel in the temple while he is serving. Gabriel tells him that his wife Elizabeth will bear a son who should be named John, and who will go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah. Zechariah doubts and becomes mute until the child is born.

events.title: The Annunciation - The Angel Gabriel to Mary
events.description: The angel Gabriel is sent to the young virgin Mary in Nazareth. He tells her that she will conceive by the Holy Spirit and give birth to a son who shall be called Jesus. He will be great and called the Son of the Most High, and his kingdom will never end.

events.title: Mary Visits Elizabeth
events.description: Mary hurries to Elizabeth in the hill country of Judea. When Elizabeth hears Mary's greeting, the baby leaps in her womb, and Elizabeth is filled with the Holy Spirit. Mary praises God with the Magnificat - a song of praise for God's great deeds for the humble.

events.title: The Birth of John the Baptist
events.description: Elizabeth gives birth to a son, and on the eighth day he is to be named. Relatives want to call him Zechariah, but Elizabeth insists on John. Zechariah confirms the name in writing, and immediately his tongue is loosed. Filled with the Holy Spirit, he prophesies about God's salvation in the Benedictus.

events.title: The Birth of Jesus in Bethlehem
events.description: Emperor Augustus issues a decree for a census, and Joseph and Mary travel from Nazareth to Bethlehem. There Mary gives birth to her firstborn son, wraps him in swaddling cloths, and lays him in a manger because there is no place for them in the inn. An angel announces the good news to shepherds, and a heavenly host praises God.

events.title: The Presentation in the Temple - Simeon and Anna
events.description: Joseph and Mary bring Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem to present him to the Lord according to the Law of Moses. The elderly Simeon takes the child in his arms and praises God with the Nunc dimittis, prophesying that Jesus will be a light for the Gentiles. The prophetess Anna also thanks God and speaks about the child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.

events.title: Jesus at Twelve Years Old in the Temple
events.description: The twelve-year-old Jesus goes with his parents to the Passover festival in Jerusalem. On the way home, they discover he is missing, and after three days of searching, they find him in the temple among the teachers. He asks questions and answers with an insight that astonishes everyone, and says to his parents: "Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?"

events.title: The Baptism of Jesus
events.description: Jesus is baptized by John in the Jordan River. As he prays, heaven opens and the Holy Spirit descends upon him like a dove. A voice from heaven says: "You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased."

events.title: The Temptation in the Wilderness
events.description: Jesus is led by the Spirit into the wilderness where he fasts for forty days and is tempted by the devil. The devil tempts him with bread, power over all the kingdoms of the world, and to throw himself down from the temple. Jesus rejects each temptation with God's word, and the devil leaves him for a time.

events.title: Jesus Preaches in Nazareth - Rejected
events.description: Jesus comes to his hometown of Nazareth and reads from the scroll of Isaiah in the synagogue: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor." He declares that this scripture is fulfilled. But the people in the synagogue become enraged and try to throw him off a cliff.

events.title: Calling of the First Disciples - The Great Catch
events.description: Jesus borrows Simon Peter's boat and teaches the crowd from the water. Afterwards, he tells Simon to cast his net into deep water. The catch is so overwhelming that the nets begin to break and two boats nearly sink. Simon falls at Jesus' feet, and Jesus says: "Do not be afraid! From now on you will catch people."

events.title: Raising of the Widow's Son at Nain
events.description: Jesus arrives in the town of Nain and encounters a funeral procession. A widow is carrying out her only son. Jesus is deeply moved with compassion, touches the bier and says: "Young man, I say to you, arise!" The dead man sits up and begins to speak, and Jesus gives him back to his mother.

events.title: The Sinful Woman Anoints Jesus' Feet
events.description: Jesus is eating at the house of Simon the Pharisee when a sinful woman enters weeping. She wets Jesus' feet with her tears, wipes them with her hair, kisses them and anoints them with expensive ointment. Simon is amazed, but Jesus tells the parable of the two debtors and forgives the woman's sins.

events.title: The Parable of the Good Samaritan
events.description: A legal expert asks Jesus what he must do to inherit eternal life and who his neighbor is. Jesus answers with a parable about a man who was attacked on the road from Jerusalem to Jericho. A priest and a Levite pass by, but a Samaritan cares for him with compassion and selflessness. Jesus says: "Go and do likewise."

events.title: Mary and Martha
events.description: Jesus arrives at a village where the sisters Martha and Mary welcome him. Mary sits at Jesus' feet and listens to his words, while Martha is busy with all the preparations. Martha asks Jesus to tell Mary to help her, but Jesus replies that Mary has chosen what is better, which will not be taken from her.

events.title: The Parable of the Prodigal Son
events.description: Jesus tells about a younger son who demands his inheritance, squanders it in a foreign country, and ends up feeding pigs. He decides to return home and ask for forgiveness. The father sees him from afar, runs to meet him, embraces him, and throws a feast. The older brother becomes angry, but the father reminds him that "your brother was dead and is alive again."

events.title: Jesus Heals Ten Lepers
events.description: On the way to Jerusalem, Jesus meets ten lepers who cry out to him for mercy. He sends them to show themselves to the priests, and as they go, they are cleansed. Only one of them - a Samaritan - returns to thank Jesus. Jesus asks: "Were not ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?"

events.title: Zacchaeus in Jericho
events.description: The wealthy tax collector Zacchaeus climbs up into a sycamore-fig tree to see Jesus pass by. Jesus looks up, calls him down, and says he will stay at his house. Zacchaeus repents and gives half of what he owns to the poor. Jesus declares that salvation has come to this house, for "the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost."

events.title: The Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem
events.description: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a young donkey while the crowd lays their cloaks on the road and praises God loudly for all the mighty works they have seen. The Pharisees ask Jesus to tell his disciples to be silent, but he answers that if they were silent, the stones would cry out. When he sees the city, he weeps over it because it did not recognize the time of its visitation.

events.title: The Last Supper
events.description: Jesus celebrates the Passover meal with his disciples. He institutes the Lord's Supper by breaking bread and sharing the cup, saying: "This is my body given for you" and "This cup is the new covenant in my blood." He tells them that one of them will betray him, and an argument arises over who is the greatest among them.

events.title: Gethsemane
events.description: Jesus goes to the Mount of Olives to pray and asks his disciples to watch with him. He falls on his knees and prays: "Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me. Yet not my will, but yours be done." An angel from heaven appears and strengthens him, and his sweat becomes like drops of blood falling to the ground.

events.title: The Trial Before Pilate and Herod
events.description: Jesus is first brought before Pilate, who finds no guilt in him and sends him on to Herod Antipas. Herod hopes to see a miracle, but Jesus gives him no answer. Herod and his soldiers mock him and send him back to Pilate. Even though Pilate declares him innocent three times, he yields to the crowd's demand for crucifixion.

events.title: The Crucifixion and the Thief
events.description: Jesus is crucified at Golgotha between two criminals. He prays: "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." One thief mocks him, but the other asks to be remembered. Jesus answers: "Today you will be with me in Paradise." Darkness covers the land for three hours, the temple curtain is torn, and Jesus cries out: "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit."

events.title: The Resurrection
events.description: Early on Sunday morning, the women come to the tomb with fragrant oils, but find the stone rolled away and the tomb empty. Two men in dazzling clothes ask them: "Why do you look for the living among the dead? He is not here; he has risen!" The women tell the apostles, but they do not believe them. Peter runs to the tomb and finds only the linen cloths.

events.title: The Road to Emmaus
events.description: Two disciples are on their way to Emmaus when Jesus joins them without being recognized by them. He explains to them everything the Scriptures say about the Messiah. When they break bread together at evening, their eyes are opened and they recognize him—but in that same moment he becomes invisible to them. They hurry back to Jerusalem to tell the others.

events.title: The Ascension
events.description: Jesus leads his disciples out to Bethany, lifts up his hands and blesses them. While he is blessing them, he is separated from them and taken up into heaven. The disciples worship him and return to Jerusalem with great joy, and they are constantly in the temple praising God.
